products.text:
Type: reclaimed wood coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor in front of a sofa; living room
Style: industrial, rustic, modern
Materials: thick reclaimed wood top with a weathered finish, brushed steel legs
Colors: warm mid brown wood, silver grey steel
Shape: rectangular thick slab top, two open U-shaped sled legs in brushed metal, square edges, low and solid, generous size
Feel: grounded, warm, rugged
Goes with: leather sofas, concrete or grey tones, black or steel accents; industrial or loft living rooms

Type: waterfall wood coffee table
Use: holding drinks and books in front of a sofa; living room
Style: minimalist, mid-century modern, modern
Materials: wood veneer with a smooth satin finish, solid wood
Colors: warm medium brown wood
Shape: waterfall form with a flat top flowing into two solid panel sides, open front and back, clean square edges, compact, simple
Feel: warm, calm, understated
Goes with: cream or grey sofas, white walls, brass or black accents; mid-century or minimalist living rooms

Type: metal frame coffee table
Use: holding drinks and decor in front of a sofa; living room
Style: industrial, modern, rustic
Materials: patchwork wood block top in mixed tones, dark metal tube frame
Colors: light natural wood, honey brown, dark gunmetal
Shape: rectangular inset top in a thin open box frame, slim square legs joined by low stretchers, light and open, medium size
Feel: airy, textured, casual
Goes with: leather or canvas sofas, brick or white walls, black metal accents; industrial or loft rooms

Type: live-edge wood coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor in front of a sofa; living room
Style: rustic, industrial, modern
Materials: solid acacia wood slab with a grey wash, raw iron legs
Colors: dark grey-brown wood, black iron
Shape: long low slab top with natural wavy live edges, two U-shaped sled legs set inward, low and wide, substantial
Feel: organic, grounded, moody
Goes with: charcoal or leather sofas, stone or concrete, black accents; rustic modern or industrial living rooms

Type: cast aluminum coffee table
Use: holding drinks in a seating area; patio, porch
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: cast aluminum with a powder-coated finish, lattice pattern top
Colors: dark bronze, near black
Shape: rectangular top with an openwork interlocking circle lattice, rounded rim, four straight tapered legs, compact and fairly light
Feel: classic, sturdy, formal
Goes with: dark wicker or metal seating, neutral cushions, stone paving; traditional outdoor spaces

Type: coffee table with magazine sling
Use: holding drinks, storing magazines and books; living room
Style: modern, industrial, mid-century modern
Materials: walnut finish wood top and lower shelf, black metal frame, tan leather sling
Colors: warm dark walnut brown, black, cognac tan
Shape: open rectangular black frame, top covering part of the length, lower shelf, hanging leather magazine sling at one end, light and open
Feel: warm, crafted, airy
Goes with: leather sofas, walnut wood, black accents, cream walls; modern or mid-century living rooms

Type: reclaimed wood storage coffee table
Use: holding drinks and storing items in front of a sofa; living room
Style: rustic, farmhouse, industrial
Materials: reclaimed pine with mixed weathered tones, dark wood or metal base, metal bar pulls
Colors: mixed natural wood, honey and grey-brown, dark grey base
Shape: boxy rectangular top with two front drawers, chunky square legs with low H-stretchers, solid and heavy
Feel: rugged, warm, lived-in
Goes with: linen or leather sofas, white walls, iron accents; rustic or farmhouse living rooms

Type: lift-top coffee table
Use: holding drinks, eating or working from the sofa, storage; living room
Style: traditional, contemporary, classic
Materials: wood composite with a smooth espresso wood-grain finish
Colors: warm reddish dark brown
Shape: rectangular top that lifts up, deep apron, open lower shelf split in two cubbies, square tapered legs, medium and solid
Feel: practical, warm, homely
Goes with: beige or grey sofas, cream walls, warm wood; traditional or family living rooms

Type: storage coffee table with drawers
Use: holding drinks and storing items in front of a sofa; living room
Style: industrial, modern, rustic
Materials: oak wood with a dark finish, brushed nickel metal base and pulls
Colors: dark warm brown wood, silver grey metal
Shape: boxy rectangular body with two front drawers and long bar pulls, raised on an open metal sled frame, chunky top, medium-wide and solid
Feel: sturdy, warm, refined
Goes with: leather or grey sofas, steel accents, neutral walls; industrial or modern living rooms

Type: slatted teak coffee table
Use: holding drinks in a seating area; patio, garden, porch
Style: coastal, traditional, classic
Materials: solid teak wood with an unfinished natural look, slatted top
Colors: light natural honey wood
Shape: rectangular slatted top with frame, square legs, low side and center stretchers, circle cutout end panels, sturdy and medium-sized
Feel: relaxed, natural, sunny
Goes with: teak or white outdoor seating, blue or neutral cushions, stone and greenery; coastal or garden spaces
